title: Onboarding PO to DevOps setup
content:
When a new team has been onboarded to DevOps tools notify PO/SO for team as well by sending a mail using template below.

Title: Team {Teamxyz} has been onboarded to IPEX DevOps platform

“Hi!

Your team has now been on-boarded to “IPEX DevOps setup” which is a set of tools that in addition to tools like Jira, Confluence and Teams help us plan, develop and deliver software. Currently IPEX DevOps setup include:

  • Azure cloud platform

  • GitHub

  • Azure DevOps

This Implies that they have access to:

  • At least one subscription in Azure, Home - Microsoft Azure

  • Repositories in Inter IKEA GitHub organization, Sign in to Inter IKEA Systems B.V. (github.com)

  • Azure DevOps project, Projects - Home (azure.com)

  • Outlook operations group, {deeplink}

And team members should be able to on-board new persons after you have added them to team as described below.

If you fell up to it, it is a good idea to participate in the flow of Pull Requests in GitHub for your team. To do so add yourself as a member and follow instructions on IPEX Home to get access to GitHub etc.

As a member of the team you get full access to resources above so it should only be granted to persons in the project. We share resources between projects in other ways. For example all team members will automatically get read access to all IPEX repositories in GitHub and be able to help out in Kompis or improving IPEX default pipeline by creating Pull Request with new functionality.

Product Owners/Solution Owners are the primary contact for giving access to new members and removing old members in the team. It is as well product owner who is subscription owner and responsible for the Azure subscriptions used by the product.

To add a new person follow the steps here, Add user to Security Group in Azure Active Directory - IPEX home - IPEX Confluence (atlassian.net)

Note that person should preferably be added with inter.ikea.com mail but it is possible to invite using other work related mail as well if needed.

Link where you add more members, {deeplink}

If you want have help by someone in the team to handle adding new members you can add that person here, {deeplink}

Niklas Johansson <niklas.johansson@inter.ikea.com>; Joakim Hogart <joakim.hogart@inter.ikea.com> are backup administrators.

If you have any question please contact, IPEX DevOps team - IPEX home - IPEX Confluence (atlassian.net)

Best regards

/DevOps team”
